observations: Royal blue shirt with tonal repeating diamond/fan geometry across body and sleeves, navy crew neck and cuffs edged in white; narrow white side panels. Product listing is a personalized 2026/27 Home shirt; the unlettered front image is used, not its numbered back.
omitted: Club emblems, manufacturer logos, sponsors, badges, numbers and lettering. Textile micro-weave is not redrawn.

visual_review.notes: Reference season and front view confirmed. Fan/diamond spacing needs a closer trace before this kit can be marked ready.
